SN-AX.claim: The scene-four draft explicitly recounts Elias and Maya reaching the master breaker panel housing together during that scene.
SN-AX.explanation: In the selected scene-four draft (catalog-complete-current-draft, version 2f9e80a0-29b4-579f-8075-b6e064788b24), Elias and Maya reach the eastern wall together and enter the service plenum.
